description: Publish a cell for every ce-net account: give a public GitHub repo (or its tarball) at a commit. Automatic checks run first: size (20 MB download, 64 MB unpacked), layout (Cargo.toml, a committed Cargo.lock, a binary named `cell`), a schema (cell.toml with name = "<area>.<function>" and [api] input and output, or a ce-wire api), no network listeners (the cell gets one JSON line on stdin and answers one line on stdout; it has no network), no secrets in the source; then it builds in the sandbox. When all pass it is listed as a community cell: tools_search finds it and any signed-in account calls it with code_call {cell}. Example: github.com/Leif-Rydenfalk/codebox-hello (hello.echo). Signed-in accounts; 3 cells and 6 builds a day per account.

cell.description: <area>.<function>, a-z 0-9 - in each part, 31 characters at most, e.g. hello.echo

git.description: the public GitHub repo: https://github.com/<owner>/<name> (or owner/name); a .../commit/<sha> or .../tree/<sha> link carries the commit too

what.description: one sentence: what it does, its input and output (200 characters)

name: cell_publish
